text: Municipal Licensing and Standards is continuously optimizing the administration of the Division's business licence and permit services to reduce regulatory burden for business operators and trade practitioners while upholding the City's mandates to mitigate potential community nuisances, protect consumers, and support public health and public safety objectives. Examples of business licences issued by Municipal Licensing and Standards include but are not limited to those for eating or drinking establishment operators, building renovators, and motorized refreshment vehicle operators. In addition to business licences, the Division administers business-related permits, including but not limited to permits to display marketing signs and permits to use public-rights-of-way.
